title: My list
allocNote: By sector, share of total value
perfNote: Hypothetical: today’s holdings held for the whole period, converted at today’s exchange rates. Purchase dates are not taken into account.
fxNote: Values converted to euros at ECB rates of {date}: {rates}
divEmpty: The data sources publish no dividend for these holdings.
demo: This is an example: its holdings and purchase prices are invented, the quotes are real. Start your own list to follow the stocks you choose and, if you enter what you paid, see your profit or loss.
watchHint: Edit a stock and enter a quantity and buy price to see its value and your profit or loss.
eStock: Choose a stock from the suggestions.
eNum: Enter a number above zero, such as 12.5 or 12,5.
eBoth: Enter both the quantity and the buy price, or leave both empty.
eDate: Enter a date that is not in the future.
rmAsk: Remove {symbol} and its purchase details from your list?
delAsk: Delete your whole list ({n}) from this browser?
deleted: Your list was deleted from this browser.
importBad: This file is not a list exported from {brand}.
